_note: URLs checked on 2026-10-03 by fetching each page/feed. Sites change, so run `python3 digest.py check-sources` on your machine before the first fetch. One broken source never stops the others.

_options.link_pattern: html_links only: regex the article URL must match
_options.url_date_pattern: html_links only: regex with 3 groups (day, month, year) to read the publish date from the article URL
_options.max_items: html_links only: newest N links per run (default 15), limits the first-run flood
_options.keep_all: true = keep items even if no topic keyword matches
_options.store_excerpt: false = keep only title and link, never the source's text
_options.pubdate_is_deadline: true = the feed's date is the deadline/event date (Taxheaven calendar)
_options.max_ahead_days: with pubdate_is_deadline: only events within this many days ahead (default 45)
